# SetSliderValue <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetSliderValue:Void slider:Int32, value:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slider` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a slider. |
| `value` | In | Int32 | required | The new position. |

## Description

Moves the slider to a value from 0 to total minus visible. It does not send an event.
